name: pi-browser
description: Pi Browser: Firefox add-on + Pi coding agent integration over Native Messaging and ACP

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-browser/protocol && npm run build -w @pi-browser/webext && npm run build -w @pi-browser/agent && npm run build -w @pi-browser/firefox && npm run build -w @pi-browser/thunderbird
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pi-browser/protocol && npm run test -w @pi-browser/agent && npm run test -w @pi-browser/firefox && npm run test -w @pi-browser/thunderbird && npm run test -w pi-browser-tests
